task_definition.task_description: Please check whether there are any PDF files in `/projects/report`, then scan the living room devices and identify the smart lock from the results. After that, check the living room light’s current status, use that to set its brightness to 70, then schedule a high-priority meeting called “Quarterly Planning Sync” with alice@company.com and bob@company.com from 2026-02-14 10:00 to 11:00 with the description “Discuss roadmap, room readiness, and workspace setup.”, send Alex a high-priority email saying the reminder was created successfully, and then create a document titled “Workspace Preparation Summary” with that same reminder message and the tags office, meeting, and workspace, and send the alert by email.
